sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: runFilter()'s in-place single-table filter path (PERFORMANCE.org Step 1) never re-synced a collapsed multi-row cell's mb-collapse-toggle-has-match indicator after applying a NEW filter's highlight, because initCollapsableColumns() — the only place that used to stamp that class — now runs once at initial render instead of after every filter pass. A match landing inside an already-built, already-collapsed cell (e.g. selecting a 'Join phrases' value like 'Featuring' that only matches a hidden <li>) showed no red/yellow 'hidden match' cue until the user manually expanded and re-collapsed that specific cell, which recomputes has-match via a separate, correct code path (ensureCollapseDelegate's click handler). Fixed by calling the existing _syncCollapseHasMatchInTable() helper (already used by applySubFilter() for the identical sub-table-filter case) right after the in-place show/hide pass, alongside the CAA/EAA bigbox sync that already runs there for the same 'used to happen via the old per-pass rebuild, now needs an explicit call' reason. The multi-table path (renderGroupedTable(), which still calls initCollapsableColumns() per sub-table on every filter pass) was unaffected.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: PERFORMANCE.org Step 2 (extend Fix C to Sort, single-table mode): applyMultiSortColumnTints() now skips filter-hidden rows when computing shade-toggle boundaries, so tint bands reflect only the visible rows again — after WIP.1 the tbody permanently holds the full row set (hidden rows kept as display:none instead of removed), which previously let hidden rows shift the tint boundaries. The CAA/EAA big-picture strip's image order no longer freezes at its original fetch-time order after a sort: WIP.1 stopped calling initCaaPics()/initEaaPics() on every action, which used to rebuild the strip (and incidentally re-sort it) on every filter/sort pass; a new _artReorderBigBoxForTable() (plus caaReorderBigBoxForTable()/eaaReorderBigBoxForTable() wrappers) now cheaply moves the existing wrapper elements to match the table's new row order via box.appendChild — no rebuild, called once per sort from the sort handler right after it reorders the live tbody rows. The single-table sort path's own live-DOM-reorder (rows moved to match the new sort order before runFilter()'s show/hide pass runs, including the cdtoc tracklist sub-row fix) had already landed as part of WIP.1.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: PERFORMANCE.org Step 3 (cache _updateAllColHeaderCounts): the per-column unique-value/multi-row header-count scan (O(rows x columns), the file's own documented worst case) now memoizes its result per <table> against a cheap O(rows) signature of the currently visible rows' data-mb-row-idx values, and skips the full recompute whenever that signature is unchanged since the last call. This makes syncCollapseButtonsWithColumnVisibility's column show/hide re-init and multi-table sub-table re-renders free when the visible row set hasn't actually changed. The one known call site that mutates cell CONTENT in place without changing which rows are visible — initReleaseEventsColumn()'s two post-population re-scans of initCollapsableColumns(), which fill previously-empty Release events/country/date cells — now explicitly calls the new _invalidateColHeaderCountsCache() first so those counts still refresh correctly instead of reading stale (pre-population) cached values.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: PERFORMANCE.org Step 1 (filter re-render, single-table mode): runFilter() no longer clones matching rows, replaces the tbody, or re-runs the post-render hook chain (initCollapsableColumns and the CAA/EAA/ERG/CDtoc it drives, plus Picard rewiring) on every keystroke. allRows are now kept as the live DOM rows throughout the session; each filter pass strips stale highlight spans and applies display:none / display:'' directly on those rows, then syncs the CAA/EAA bigbox via the existing caaUpdateBigBoxForTable()/eaaUpdateBigBoxForTable() helpers (previously only used by sub-table filters). The hook chain now runs exactly once — already true for the live fetch pipeline (startFetchingProcess), and newly hoisted into the disk-load/hydration path (initCollapsableColumns moved after updateH2Count() so its global toggle button can find filterContainer already attached; initCaaPics/initEaaPics/initCaaInlinePics/initEaaInlinePics called directly there since runFilter() no longer initialises them for single-table mode). Sort reorders the live tbody rows in place (appendChild loop) before the show/hide filter pass runs, so visible rows stay in sorted order. Fixed a regression the show/hide approach would otherwise introduce for cdtoc pages: a filtered-out or re-sorted row's tracklist sub-row (a synthetic sibling <tr> from _cdtocInitTracklistToggles(), not part of allRows) is now hidden/moved alongside its parent row instead of being orphaned.
